# Labels Back for 2026.11

Version 1.20.1 keeps the visual editor readable on Home Assistant 2026.11.

## The editor

- **Every switch has its label again.** Home Assistant 2026.11 removes the component the editor used to label its switches, so the switches would have stood there without text. The labels now use Home Assistant's own way of labelling a switch: the switch stays in front of its text, and a click on the text toggles it.

## Also in this release

- **MapLibre 6.16.** The map library is updated from 6.15 to 6.16. Dependencies are updated.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Home Assistant 2026.6 or newer.
